## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Broad sector strength contrasts with mixed market internals: SPY (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, VXX (1W: +3.33% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY — flat risk ratios produce a neutral call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit neutral: HYG (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD → flat. Short-term fear tick: VXX ↑ (1W: +3.33% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY; sector breadth leadership from Health/Biotech: XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Bonds showing resilience: TLT ↑ (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND while equities soft: SPY ↓ (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND — financial conditions read neutral-to-accommodative with pockets of risk-off in large caps.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Health and Biotech leading: XLV (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing steady gains: XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND while Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND — style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US small caps resilient: IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, while broad US large caps are softer: SPY (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND. EM/China underperform: EEM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.89%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed — IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND signals risk-taking, but crypto and high-beta are weak: IBIT (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.57% | 1M: +0.23%) CORRECTION; speculative appetite selective, not broad.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals and oil soft: GLD (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -10.47% | 1M: -21.07%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND; natural gas standout: UNG (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed-to-soft: XLE (1W: +0.85% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY while Brent (BNO) remains BELOW TREND (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -21.18%) — energy showing short rebounds amid a larger downtrend.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed divergence: sector breadth is strong (8/11) yet broad-market ETFs are mixed — SPY (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND vs IWM (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND; notable corrections in Tech/semis — SOXX (1W: -7.74% | 1M: +4.65%) CORRECTION signals momentum hiccups (MAJOR divergence).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor allocations into Health/Financials and select small-cap exposure given breadth: XLV (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging Tech: XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND and broad large-cap growth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Healthcare/biotech — XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND; Financials — XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND; Materials — XME (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -12.06%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil/precious metals — BNO (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -10.47% | 1M: -21.07%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency/watch trigger), HYG/LQD spread ~tightness threshold (monitor HYG (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND), XLK/XLF cross (watch XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND) for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XBI (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +15.68%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +4.55%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: Tech weakness XLK (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -7.74% | 1M: +4.65%) CORRECTION — watch for spillover and VXX (1W: +3.33% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY upticks.
